title: Spanish Tortilla Quesadillas
description: A twist on traditional quesadillas using Spanish tortillas and filling for a unique flavor.
instructions: 1. Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium heat.
2. Add 1/4 cup of olive oil to the skillet.
3. Place a Spanish tortilla in the skillet and sprinkle with cheese and filling.
4. Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling.
5. Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the filling is heated through.
6. Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2 minutes or until the other side is crispy.
7. Repeat with the remaining tortillas and filling.
8. Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve hot.
